shell_commands_self_reported.command: cd <WORKSPACE>/project/vendor && for d in *; do echo "== $d"; cat $d/manifest.json; echo; head -c 300 $d/LICENSE; echo; done
cd <WORKSPACE>/project/vendor && for d in cronwise gluelib hashmint ledgerkit pixelgrid signalbus tinyqueue; do echo "== $d"; cat "$d/manifest.json"; echo; head -c 300 "$d/LICENSE"; echo; done

cd <WORKSPACE>/project/vendor && cat cronwise/manifest.json cronwise/LICENSE | head -40; echo ====; cat gluelib/manifest.json gluelib/LICENSE | head -40; echo ====; cat hashmint/manifest.json hashmint/LICENSE | head -40

cd <WORKSPACE>/project/vendor && cat ledgerkit/manifest.json ledgerkit/LICENSE | head -40; echo ====; cat pixelgrid/manifest.json pixelgrid/LICENSE | head -40; echo ====; cat signalbus/manifest.json signalbus/LICENSE | head -40; echo ====; cat tinyqueue/manifest.json tinyqueue/LICENSE | head -40

cd <WORKSPACE>/project/vendor && for f in gluelib hashmint pixelgrid signalbus tinyqueue; do echo "---- $f manifest"; grep '"license"' $f/manifest.json; echo "---- $f LICENSE"; head -n 6 $f/LICENSE; done

cd <WORKSPACE>/project/vendor && grep -H '"license"' gluelib/manifest.json hashmint/manifest.json pixelgrid/manifest.json signalbus/manifest.json tinyqueue/manifest.json && head -n 6 gluelib/LICENSE && echo ---- && head -n 6 hashmint/LICENSE && echo ---- && head -n 6 pixelgrid/LICENSE && echo ---- &
